items.scope:
Vulnerabilities affecting the products, their security-relevant components, and functionality developed and maintained by companies within the EasyVista Group, including:

OTRS - OTRS and features developed and maintained by OTRS GmbH; OTRS container distribution bundle, including container images customized, configured, or maintained by OTRS GmbH; OTRS SaaS and platform components developed and operated by OTRS GmbH; and security-relevant functionality and integrations developed and maintained by OTRS GmbH.

EasyVista - EV Service Manager; EV Service Apps; EV Self Help; EV Observe; EV Digital Experience Monitoring; EV Reach; and EV Discovery.
openGauss issues only.
Siemens issues only.
All products and projects in which OpenVPN is directly involved commercially and for OpenVPN community projects, including Private Tunnel.
Vulnerabilities in all Ubiquiti products and products of Ubiquiti subsidiaries only.

Vulnerabilities in Protect AI products, third-party code vulnerabilities reported by researchers collaborating with huntr and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Protect AI that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Airoha product issues only.
ClickHouse-owned products, not including end-of-life components.

System vulnerabilities regarding the Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch Lite, and vulnerabilities regarding Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch applications for which Nintendo is the publisher worldwide.
Vestel-owned brands and products only.
Flock branded hardware and software products only.
Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.
ASUSTOR issues only.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-FI, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-FI for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
All ESET products only and vulnerabilities discovered by ESET that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.

Products supported by Schneider Electric and its affiliates, including products branded Schneider Electric or any other brands owned or controlled by Schneider Electric (such as but not limited to APC, Eliwell, Proface, ProLeit, Lauritz Knudsen Electrical & Automation, etc.), excluding Aveva and RIB products.
Hitachi products excluding Hitachi Energy and Hitachi Vantara products.
Current versions of LINE Messenger Application for iOS, Android, Mac, and Windows, plus LINE Open Source projects hosted on https://github.com/line.

Vulnerabilities in Delinea products or services listed on delinea.com, or vulnerabilities in third-party products or services discovered by or reported to Delinea, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All Arista products only.
Bizerba products only.
All Gallagher security products only.
NVIDIA issues only.
AxxonSoft products and solutions, Abetechs GmbH products and solutions (GRUNDIG security products, and C-WERK software solutions).
Eaton issues only.
Trend Micro supported products, including any end-of-life products.
Pandora FMS, Pandora ITSM, and Pandora RC issues only.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.

Products and technologies branded by Bull and its subsidiaries, unless covered by the scope of another CNA as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software and hardware discovered by Bull and its subsidiaries that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Mautic core and officially supported plugins.
All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.
Supported Secomea products only.
Vulnerabilities in Commvault SaaS and software products only.
Genetec products and solutions only.
NEC issues only.
All Snow Software products.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SRA that are not within the scope of another CNA.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash, X-Pack, and Elastic Cloud Enterprise products only.
Zoom and Keybase issues only.
Vulnerabilities in supported Ivanti products and infrastructure, excluding third-party components, and meeting severity thresholds defined in Ivanti’s Disclosure Policy found here.
All automotive and related infrastructure vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Black Duck (formerly Synopsys Software Integrity Group) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Black Duck that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
All HYPR products only.
All WatchDog products.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.

All products for Haverford Systems brands, PTZOptics and HuddleCamHD (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Haverford Systems that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in all of Insyde Software’s firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by Insyde Software that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
All Mattermost issues, and vulnerabilities discovered by Mattermost that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
